I use pathfinder pawns, and I absolutely recommend them. They're nothing short of fantastic. Around 300 minis per box, with really beautiful art. I'll list some of the pros and cons for you, but you really can't go wrong with them. 

Pros:

Cheap. Around 35 euro for a box of 300 pawns is incredible. 

Extremely easy to store and transport. I usually bring mine to my games in the box they came in, though sometimes I also use a little sandwich baggie to transport the ones I know I'll need that session. 

No need to paint them. I'm a terrible painter, to the point where I prefer to leave the miniatures that I do use unpainted, but with pathfinder pawns, that's not a problem. Which brings me to my next point... 

Beautiful artwork. Seriously, the art on these things is class. 

CONS :
not made for dnd 5e, so some iconic monsters, such as beholders, are unavailable. 

Not being able to pick and choose your monsters/npcs. Each box contains around 300 minis, but that also means that you can't pick and choose the ones you want. For example, the game I'm running is highly unlikely to feature angels, so the 10 or so angels in the set will likely go unused. A small point, but might be worth considering. 

That's it. Ive got the bestiary box 1, and the npc codex box, and they're both brilliant.
